adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Use of mudras to challenge the opponent.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: The performer moves between the pandal and the house entrance.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Kali jumps from the audience area to enter the scene.
movement_profile.partnering: The dance is a staged combat between two performers.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and aggressive for Darika; martial and poised for Kali.

signature_moves.description: A pursuit sequence where Kali searches for the hiding asura in all directions.
signature_moves.name: Panjupidutam

music_profile.sound_description: The music is dominated by the rhythmic, percussive sounds of the chenda and elathalam, creating a tense atmosphere for the ritual battle.

basic_steps: Guru Puja: Bowing down facing the stage to honor the master.
Darika Entry: Entering from behind a curtain with a shout and Kalarippayattu-inspired steps.
Mudras: Performing hand gestures in each direction to call the opponent to battle.
Panjupidutam: A pursuit sequence where the dancer searches for the opponent in all directions.
teaching.formation: The dance takes place within a decorated pandal in a cleared yard.
